nom: Cetaphil Skin Activator Hydrating & Firming Cream

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some describing years of chronic dryness, cracking, or flaking, consistently report the cream relieves dryness and keeps skin hydrated for hours, with no dissenting reports on hydration.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers describe the fragrance-free, hypoallergenic formula as gentle and non-irritating, recommending it for sensitive skin and even reporting improvement in a family member's eczema, though one reviewer reports a severe allergic reaction to an ingredient and could not continue using it.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 30s to 60s who mention age-related firmness loss report the cream feels targeted at their needs, most describing smoother, plumper-looking skin, though several say any visible firming is subtle rather than dramatic.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers, especially those using it consistently for two or more weeks on crepey or sagging areas like arms, legs, elbows, and the neck, report visibly smoother, firmer, less crepey skin, some noting fewer visible face creases within days to a month; several others, however, say they feel only the hydration and see no real change in firmness, some directly noting the product doesn't live up to its firming claims.
concerns.dehydration: Virtually every reviewer reports strong, long-lasting hydration, often describing skin as instantly softer, smoother, and moisturized for the full day or overnight, with several specifically noting relief from years of chronic dryness, cracking, or flaking, and no reviewer in this set reporting the cream failed to hydrate.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no irritation while using this cream, several specifically noting it caused no stinging or redness even on sensitive skin; one reviewer, however, reports a severe allergic reaction to an ingredient and was unable to continue using the product.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers explicitly credit the cream's CICA and AHA combination with repairing or strengthening their skin's moisture barrier, with one saying she could feel her barrier healing within three days.
concerns.oiliness: Despite its thick, rich texture, the overwhelming majority of reviewers say the cream absorbs fully without leaving a greasy or oily feel, though a small number describe it as slightly heavy or better suited to cooler weather than hot, humid conditions.

aspects.libelle: Rich, thick texture that absorbs without grease
Jar packaging requires dipping fingers in
Long-lasting tub, goes a long way
Especially well-suited to cold, dry weather

extraits.texte: I tried the jar version of this lotion for my arms. The texture is nice — rich enough to feel moisturizing but not greasy, and it has no scent, which I really appreciate. It does make my skin feel softer and more comfortable, but I haven't seen the firming or dramatic change in crepey skin that the product claims. It's a decent everyday moisturizer, just not a miracle in a jar. I received this item as a gift in exchange for my honest review.
I had a terrible allergic reaction to something in this products. I was not able to review it in its entirety for that reason. Posting because I have to.

This thick rich body cream is great for aging, sagging or dry skin. Key ingredients include Sunflower Seed and Sweet Almond Oils, plus Mandelic Acid and encapsulated Centella Asiatica that helps increase skin cell turnover and restore the skin's moisture barrier. I like how it smooths out any dry patches and reduces crepey skin after continued use. Although it is a thicker texture, it still absorbs quickly without any stickiness or greasy feel after applying. I applied this 2x per day on my legs and found it very hydrating. Legs are smooth and stay moisturized all day (or night). This will especially be great in the winter months, but it is a little bit heavy for my skin in hot humid months.

I did not think this would improve my dry creepy skin. Why you say?… because my mom always told me"you were born with dry skin." It is true, I have always battled dry skin. Now as I enter my 60's, creepy skin on my arms calves and chest have arrived! To my pleasant surprise this product has truly made a difference. I see visible changes in the dryness of these areas of skin and it has definitely improved the texture, creating nice smooth skin. I cannot thank you enough!

extraits.titre: Rich texture with moisture that lasts!
extraits.texte: The Cetaphil Skin Activator Hydrating & Firming Cream has a rich, thick texture that is great for thin, fragile skin. Over time, with consistent use, it helps repair the skin barrier. It instantly moisturizes and improves the appearance of crepey looking skin. The moisture boost lasts for days with CICA (Centella Asiatica) and AHA (Mandelic Acid). It's also hypoallergenic, fragrance-free, paraben-free, and non-comedogenic which is great for sensitive skin like mine. I like to use it right out of the shower, I feel like I get the best absorption then.

At 45, I've been noticing my skin losing some firmness, so I tried the Cetaphil Skin Activator Hydrating & Firming Cream. I love that it uses AHA (Mandelic Acid) to smooth out dull, uneven skin and CICA (Centella Asiatica) to strengthen the moisture barrier and plump things back up. After consistent use, my skin feels more hydrated, looks smoother, and definitely less crepey.
